description: This file defines a thread-safe JSON storage system and a repository class for managing note objects, including methods for creating, updating, retrieving, listing, and deleting notes. It also handles persistence to a JSON file and includes a singleton pattern for repository access.

classes.name: PersistenceError
classes.description: Exception class raised when there is an error during notes persistence operations.

classes.name: _ThreadSafeJSONStore
classes.description: A minimal thread-safe JSON file store that handles loading and saving a list of notes.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing note objects with methods to create, read, update, delete, and list notes, with persistence.
